description: This file defines the AI strategies for a Ludo game, including an abstract strategy interface, factory for creating strategies based on difficulty, and concrete implementations for easy (random move) and medium (heuristic-based) AI. It also contains logic to evaluate moves in the medium strategy.

classes.name: LudoAiStrategy
classes.description: Abstract interface for implementing a strategy to select a move in the Ludo game.

classes.name: LudoAiStrategies
classes.description: Factory class providing method to create AI strategy instances based on difficulty level.

classes.name: EasyRandomStrategy
classes.description: AI implementation that selects a legal move uniformly at random.

classes.name: MediumHeuristicStrategy
classes.description: AI implementation that evaluates legal moves with heuristics such as capturing, safety, and progress, then chooses the best one.

classes.name: _ScoredMove
classes.description: Helper class representing a move with an associated heuristic score used internally in MediumHeuristicStrategy.

methods.name: selectMove
methods.description: Method for selecting a move based on the strategy; implemented differently across strategies.

methods.name: forDifficulty
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate a specific AI strategy based on difficulty level.

methods.name: name
methods.description: Getter providing a label for the strategy, used in UI or debugging.

methods.name: _scoreMove
methods.description: Calculates heuristic score for a move in the medium strategy.

methods.name: _wouldCaptureOpponent
methods.description: Determines if a move would result in capturing an opponent's piece.

methods.name: _progressDelta
methods.description: Calculates progress difference before and after a move.

methods.name: _approxProgress
methods.description: Estimates the progress of a piece along the track toward home.

methods.name: _computeNextPosition
methods.description: Locally computes the next position of a piece after a move, used for move evaluation.
